sections.text: What I Want to Do Is Top Priority!

-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 90 seconds.
All stats increasing effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 70 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[Non-lethal] Chisato Nishikigi or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
